messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for taking the time to chat with me today about the university student portal. To start, could you share what the main goals are for enhancing the portal? What do you hope to achieve with these new features?

Hey! Thanks for talking with me too. So, honestly, I just want the portal to be a bit easier to use. Like, the timetable is really frustrating right now. I wish it could be clearer and more personal, you know? Also, it would be super helpful to get notifications when grades come out. Sometimes, I forget to check, and then it's a scramble. And I think it would be nice to have a way to give feedback on the modules I take, just to share what works and what doesn't. That’s pretty much it!

Got it! So, it sounds like you're looking for a clearer and more personal timetable, notifications for grades, and a way to give feedback on modules. That's really helpful. 

Could you tell me a bit more about how you'd like the personalised timetable management to work? What features would make it easier for you?

Yeah, so for the timetable, I think it would be great if I could, like, colour-code my classes. That way, I could easily see what’s what at a glance. Also, if I could hide classes that are cancelled or not happening, that would really clear things up. And having a spot to add in my own study times would help too, just to keep everything in one place. It’s just a bit messy right now, you know?

That makes a lot of sense! So, to clarify, you would like features for colour-coding classes, hiding cancelled classes, and adding your own study times to the timetable. 

Moving on to the grade notifications, how would you like to receive those notifications? What would work best for you?

Oh, I think it would be cool to get notifications on my phone, maybe like a push notification or something. I usually check my emails, but sometimes I miss things that way. So, if it could pop up on my phone, that would be awesome. Just something quick to let me know when new grades are out!

Got it! So, you would prefer to receive push notifications on your phone for new grades instead of email notifications. That sounds really convenient!

Lastly, can you tell me more about what kind of feedback you would like to provide on the modules? What features would you find useful in the feedback system?

Sure! I think it would be helpful if there was a simple way to leave feedback after the modules are done. Like, maybe just some questions about what I thought of the content and how it was taught, and if the resources were good. It doesn’t need to be super complicated, just a few questions to fill out. I just want to make sure my thoughts get heard!

That sounds really straightforward! So, you would like a simple feedback system with questions about the content, teaching methods, and resources after completing modules. That's a great way to make sure your opinions are shared.

To summarize, we have the following clear requirements so far:
1. Personalised timetable management with features for colour-coding classes, hiding cancelled classes, and adding study times.
2. Push notifications on your phone for new grade updates.
3. A simple feedback system with questions about module content, teaching methods, and resources.

If there are any limitations or restrictions that we should consider for these enhancements, could you let me know?

Um, I haven't really thought about any limitations or restrictions. I just want the features to work well together and be easy to use. I guess it would be annoying if I had to sign in to something extra or deal with complicated stuff. But other than that, I’m not sure what else to consider.

Thanks for sharing that! So, to recap, you want the new features to work well together and be easy to use without requiring extra sign-ins or complicated processes. 

I think we have gathered five clear requirements for the enhancements to the student portal:
1. Personalised timetable management with features for colour-coding classes, hiding cancelled classes, and adding study times.
2. Push notifications on your phone for new grade updates.
3. A simple feedback system with questions about module content, teaching methods, and resources.
4. The new features should work well together and be easy to use.
5. Avoid extra sign-ins or complicated processes.

REQUIREMENTS_COMPLETE
